# pbs_webhook_notification (Resource)

Manages a Webhook notification target.

Configure a webhook endpoint to receive HTTP notifications from PBS about backup jobs,
verification tasks, and system events.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "webhook_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Webhook target that authenticates with a secret token. Secrets are
# referenced in the body and header templates as {{ secrets.<name> }}.
resource "pbs_webhook_notification" "example" {
  name   = "ops-webhook"
  url    = "https://hooks.example.com/pbs"
  method = "post"

  headers = {
    "Content-Type"  = "application/json"
    "Authorization" = "Bearer {{ secrets.token }}"
  }

  body = jsonencode({
    title    = "{{ title }}"
    message  = "{{ message }}"
    severity = "{{ severity }}"
  })

  secret = {
    token = var.webhook_token
  }

  comment = "Notifications for the ops team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique name identifier for the Webhook notification target.
- `url` (String) Webhook URL where notifications will be sent (e.g., `https://hooks.example.com/notify`).

### Optional

- `body` (String) Custom request body template. Can use template variables for notification data.
- `comment` (String) A comment describing this notification target.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this notification target. Defaults to `false`.
- `headers` (Map of String) Custom HTTP headers to include in webhook requests. Specify as key-value pairs.
- `method` (String) HTTP method for webhook requests. Valid values: `post`, `put`. Defaults to `post`.
- `secret` (Map of String, Sensitive) Named secrets that can be referenced in the `body` and `headers` templates as `{{ secrets.<name> }}`, e.g. `secret = { token = var.webhook_token }` used as `{{ secrets.token }}`. PBS stores the values protected and never returns them, so changes made to secret values outside Terraform cannot be detected (added or removed secret names are). Secret values cannot be imported.

### Read-Only

- `origin` (String) Origin of this configuration as reported by PBS (e.g., `user`, `builtin`).
